name: Beckham
s: Featuring never-before-seen footage and exclusive interviews with David Beckham's wife, family, past managers and fellow athletes, this rousing and deeply personal series follows his meteoric rise from humble beginnings to global football stardom.

paragraphs.text: Beckham is a 2023 British four-part docuseries created for Netflix. It was directed by Fisher Stevens, and stars David Beckham.
